suite.headline: One app is close to its commercial peer, four are broadly built with disclosed gaps, and two are early prototypes; across the suite there are about 208,400 lines of application source and 13,050 automated test cases.
suite.blurb: Monet is seven desktop creative applications — image editing, vector illustration, photo cataloguing, audio, video, motion graphics and 2D game authoring — built as a single monorepo. Every one of them is a Tauri 2 and React app sharing one UI design system, a merged Rust/WebAssembly render engine, a universal document format, and a generated automation surface that lets an agent drive the running app.

sharedFoundations.name: Monet UI design system
sharedFoundations.detail: packages/monet-ui provides the shared React chrome, panels, dialogs and native window styling, with one accent colour per app (raster, vector, motion, audio) so the seven apps look like one suite.

sharedFoundations.name: Rust/WASM render engine
sharedFoundations.detail: packages/engine is a single merged crate with raster, vector and camera-raw pipelines compiled to WebAssembly; Vision and Galerie run on it fully, Artisan uses it for an opt-in raster path, and Cinema keeps its own compositing crate.

sharedFoundations.name: Universal .monet document format
sharedFoundations.detail: One container format with per-app extensions (.monetgfx, .mvision, .mgal, .mart, .mjou). Any app can open another app's file, and payloads it does not understand are written back out unchanged, so a round trip never destroys a sibling app's work.

sharedFoundations.name: Generated MCP surface
sharedFoundations.detail: Each app tags commands with @mcp and generates a tool manifest served by a native Tauri plugin on its own port, so an external agent can drive the running application — from 15 verbs in Galerie to 118 in Rythme.

sharedFoundations.name: Tauri 2 desktop shell
sharedFoundations.detail: Every app ships as a native desktop window rather than a browser tab, with file-type associations, scoped filesystem capabilities, a fixed content-security policy and a per-app dev port checked by a shared test.

apps.name: Monet Vision
apps.description: Monet Vision is a desktop editor for pixel images, covering layers, masks, selections, painting, adjustments, filters, text and vector shapes. It renders through the shared Rust/WebAssembly engine, reads and writes formats from PNG to PSD, and can be driven from outside the app over MCP.

areas.name: Adjustments & filters
areas.detail: Levels, curves, hue/saturation, colour balance, channel mixer, selective colour, shadows/highlights plus roughly 60 filter-gallery, blur, sharpen, noise and stylize filters with live preview.

areas.name: Layers & masks
areas.detail: Layers, groups, clipping, layer and vector masks, 27 blend modes plus group pass-through, fill and adjustment layers, smart objects, layer effects, layer comps and labels.

areas.name: Painting & retouch
areas.detail: Pressure-aware brushes with tips, presets and smoothing, eraser, clone stamp, healing, dodge/burn, bucket fill, gradients, patterns and history brush.

areas.name: Selection & transform
areas.detail: Marquee, lasso, magic wand, quick and object select, colour range, select-and-mask, feathering, crop and perspective crop, free transform, warp and liquify meshes and straighten.

areas.name: File I/O & export
areas.detail: PNG, JPEG, WebP, BMP, TIFF, GIF, AVIF, PDF, SVG and PSD import/export, native HEIC decode, layered .mvision projects, .monetgfx containers, slices, batch processing and web-export estimates.

areas.name: Automation & MCP
areas.detail: 90 @mcp-wrapped commands with a generated 90-tool manifest and an mcp:check gate, Actions record and play with action sets, a sandboxed Worker scripting console, droplets, a presets manager and keyboard shortcuts.

areas.name: Text & vector
areas.detail: Editable text layers with shaping, glyph panel, optical kerning, hanging punctuation, type-on-path and warp, plus vector shapes, pen paths, path operations and vector masks rasterized by the engine.

areas.name: Camera Raw & colour
areas.detail: Camera Raw workspace with presets, sidecars and an 8-slot filmstrip, DNG handling, ICC profile import, soft proofing with black-point compensation, ICC-CMYK PSD export through the bundled ISOcoated_v2_300_eci press profile, and histogram/vectorscope/waveform scopes.

areas.name: Desktop shell
areas.detail: Tauri 2 shell with a macOS menu bar, window chrome, screen modes, workspace presets and tabs, atomic saves, scoped filesystem capabilities, C2PA signing, printing and auto-recover.

areas.name: On-device ML
areas.detail: onnxruntime-web wiring for style transfer, subject selection, MI-GAN/LaMa inpainting, super-resolution, denoise, sky replacement and Stable Diffusion 1.5 with a model registry and licence/integrity gates.

apps.name: Monet Artisan
apps.description: Monet Artisan is a desktop editor for vector artwork, where drawings are made of paths, shapes and text instead of pixels. It ships 75 tools, 28 panels and boolean path operations, and opens or saves SVG, PDF, Illustrator, CorelDRAW and Monet container files.
apps.maturityLabel: Broad Illustrator coverage, real gaps remain

areas.name: Document engine & store
areas.detail: Pure-TypeScript geometry (vector, matrix, bezier, bounding box, path, offset), the item/layer/artboard document model with query and factories, and an Immer-backed observable store with transactions, labelled snapshot undo/redo capped at 250 entries and selection state.

areas.name: Tools & canvas
areas.detail: 75 registered tools covering selection, direct and group select, lasso, magic wand, pen and anchor editing, pencil, paintbrush, blob brush, width, puppet warp, reshape, 7 liquify, 6 symbolism and 7 graph tools, shapes, transforms, shape builder, eraser, knife, scissors, gradient, mesh, perspective grid, live paint, artboard, slice, dimension and view tools.

areas.name: Layers & artboards
areas.detail: Layer tree with lock, hide and template layers, collect-into-layer, release-to-layers, hide/lock-above, multi-artboard create/duplicate/delete, guides and rulers, slices, symbols, links, variables and actions.

areas.name: Shell, menus & panels
areas.detail: Tauri 2 native-vibrancy window with Monet chrome, 28 docked panels, a 222-entry menu bar, 165 undo-wrapped commands, a keyboard shortcut registry with its own panel, tool rail flyouts and an options bar.

areas.name: Path ops & pathfinder
areas.detail: All ten Pathfinder shape modes and effects plus offset path, outline stroke, simplify, join, average, round corners, compound paths, blends and the distort family (warp, roughen, tweak, zigzag, twist, pucker/bloat, scribble, free distort, liquify).

areas.name: Rendering
areas.detail: React SVG renderer for artboards, items, paints, patterns, stroke alignment, caps and joins, blend modes, effect filters, outline mode, selection and tool overlays, guides and rulers, with an alternate Rust/WASM raster surface behind an opt-in flag.

areas.name: Type & typography
areas.detail: Point, area and on-path type with inline editing, font switching, character, paragraph and type-style panels, case and smart-punctuation transforms, text decoration and caps, and lossless SVG/.artisan text round-trip.

areas.name: Color & appearance
areas.detail: Solid, gradient and pattern paints, linear and radial gradients only, a quad-grid mesh approximation, swatches with ASE/ACO/ACT import, a colour harmony guide, edit-colors operations limited to invert, grayscale, saturate and desaturate, thin graphic-style and effect wrappers, an ordered appearance stack, opacity masks, blend modes and five live effect types.

areas.name: File I/O & export
areas.detail: Imports .artisan JSON, the .monet container family, SVG/SVGZ, PDF, AI/EPS/PS and CDR through a magic-byte dispatcher with structured fidelity reports.

areas.name: MCP & collaboration
areas.detail: 31 generated @mcp verbs served by the Tauri monet_mcp plugin on port 48212 against 165 total commands, plus opt-in Yjs collaboration that binds the store and renders live cursors.

apps.name: Monet Galerie
apps.description: Monet Galerie is a desktop application for organising a photo library and editing raw camera files without changing the originals. It keeps its catalog in SQLite, renders edits through the shared Rust/WebAssembly engine, and delivers results through export, print, web gallery, slideshow and book modules.

areas.name: Export & publish
areas.detail: Export dialog with presets, JPEG, PNG, TIFF8, PSD, 16-bit TIFF, linear DNG and original formats, watermarks, output sharpening, filename templates, metadata scoping and location removal, C2PA content credentials, post-export actions, publish services and an Edit-in-Vision round trip.

areas.name: Library & catalog
areas.detail: Import with presets and previews, folder tree and sync, watched folders and auto-import, collections and smart collections, stacking, virtual copies, ratings, flags and labels, grid, loupe, compare and survey views, filmstrip, painter and filter bar.

areas.name: RAW & render engine
areas.detail: Native RAW decode to scene-linear 16-bit RGBA, the shared Rust/WASM Camera-Raw develop ABI, ICC colour management, draft and full render tiers, a develop worker and scheduler, and DNG and linear-DNG output.

areas.name: Metadata & keywords
areas.detail: IPTC and EXIF metadata panel with batch edit, metadata presets, keyword list, sets, entry and file import/export, XMP sidecar read/write with auto-write, capture-time editing and geotagging.

areas.name: Catalog storage & shell
areas.detail: Tauri 2 native backend of about 23,000 lines of Rust with a versioned SQLite catalog at schema v16, atomic publish, backup policy, catalog merge, the .mgal universal container, previews and a secondary display window.

areas.name: Develop module
areas.detail: Basic, Tone Curve, Color Mixer, Color Grading, Detail, Optics, Transform, Effects, Calibration, Profile and Point Color panels plus masks, heal and dust spots, red-eye, crop and straighten, targeted adjustment, before/after, reference view, presets, snapshots, history, copy/paste and auto sync.

areas.name: Print, Web, Slideshow, Book
areas.detail: Print module with templates, pagination and page decoration, web gallery generation, slideshow with styles, templates and export, and a book layout module short of the full peer feature set.

areas.name: Map & geolocation
areas.detail: GPS coordinates on photos, a geotag dialog and location handling on export, but no Map module at all — no map view, tracklog import or reverse geocoding.

apps.name: Monet Rythme
apps.description: Monet Rythme is a desktop workstation for recording, arranging and repairing audio across multiple tracks. Its processing, analysis and file-format code is framework-free TypeScript covering roughly fifty effects plus noise, hum and click removal, and it exports WAV and AIFF.

areas.name: MCP control
areas.detail: 118 generated MCP tools covering analysis, clip and range edits, effects, markers, export, panels and preferences, served natively by the monet-mcp Tauri plugin.

areas.name: Effects & DSP
areas.detail: About 50 processors: amplify and normalize, biquad plus parametric, graphic, FFT, scientific and notch EQ, compressor, multiband, limiter, true peak, gate, delay, echo and analog delay, four reverbs, modulation, distortion, waveshaper, time stretch and pitch shift, and sidechain duck, compress and gate.

areas.name: Multitrack editing
areas.detail: Clip move, trim, split and razor, ripple delete, insert silence, range cut/copy/paste, mix paste, crossfade, merge, clip groups, snapping, markers, per-clip gain and fades.

areas.name: Restoration
areas.detail: Spectral noise reduction with a captured print, hiss reduction, adaptive noise reduction, DeHummer, DeClicker, DeClipper, DeReverb, automatic phase correction and delete silence.

areas.name: Analysis & metering
areas.detail: FFT spectrum with peak hold, peak and RMS levels, BS.1770 loudness with LRA and true peak, loudness time series, amplitude statistics and histogram, phase analysis, vectorscope, spectrogram, YIN pitch detection and beat/tempo detection.

areas.name: UI & commands
areas.detail: Audition-shaped 266-entry menu bar, dockable panels for files, effects rack, markers, properties, analyze, mixer and history, timeline and waveform-editor canvases, tool rail, transport bar, workspace layouts and keyboard shortcut presets.

areas.name: File IO & formats
areas.detail: WAV at 8, 16, 24 and 32 bit plus float and AIFF/AIFC codecs with cue and MARK marker chunks, .monet container sessions, marker CSV round-trip, Premiere EDL and XML, and batch export.

areas.name: Plugins & hosting
areas.detail: VST3, VST2 and AudioUnit path inventory and a validation model only — plugin-inventory.ts declares canProcess false and hostStatus inventoryOnly, so no plug-in is ever loaded or processed.

areas.name: Playback & recording
areas.detail: Web Audio transport with per-track gain, pan, mute and solo, master fader, looping and playhead, input recording, device enumeration, output sink selection and control-surface mapping.

areas.name: Collaboration
areas.detail: The timeline structure syncs through monet-collab with PCM stripped to descriptors, so unknown buffers resolve to silence because the audio blob side-channel is unbuilt.

apps.name: Monet Jouer
apps.description: Monet Jouer is a desktop editor for 2D scenes and animations whose centre canvas is a live Phaser 4 game, so edits, physics and keyframes play back in the real engine. Projects save as Monet containers and export as standalone Phaser code that runs in a browser.

areas.name: Phaser code export
areas.detail: Deterministic generation of Phaser 4 code covering scene classes, chained tweens, sprite animations, transitions and physics bodies, emitted as standalone CDN-pinned HTML or a .js module with a live code preview panel.

areas.name: Scene transitions
areas.detail: Fade, slide, wipe and zoom transitions between scenes, triggered manually or on pointer-down, key press or timer, authored in a panel and emitted into the exported game.

areas.name: Live viewport editing
areas.detail: A real Phaser game canvas with select, move, scale, rotate, marquee and place tools, grid plus position, rotation and scale snapping, pivot handling, lock, frame-selected and move-to-view.

areas.name: Documents, MCP & collab
areas.detail: Universal Monet container save and open as .mjou that couriers foreign entries back out untouched, a defensive schema-checked parser, clone-on-write undo/redo, 22 MCP verbs with a generated manifest, and opt-in Yjs collaboration.

areas.name: Scene & object model
areas.detail: Multi-scene projects with sprite, image, text, shape and container objects, a nestable hierarchy with reparenting, search, sort and collapse, tags, sorting layers, selection sets and isolate mode.

areas.name: Animation timeline
areas.detail: Per-object keyframe tracks on ten numeric properties, 18 easing curves, a scrubbable playhead with live playback, autokey and record, track mute/solo/lock, keyframe copy and frame stepping.

areas.name: Assets & sprite animations
areas.detail: Image, spritesheet and audio assets embedded as data URLs, drag-and-drop import, spritesheet frame animations played in the editor, filter mode, pixel-art mode, sliced and tiled sprites and flipping.

areas.name: Physics & camera
areas.detail: Arcade physics bodies (dynamic, static, kinematic) with velocity, acceleration, angular acceleration, gravity and bounce, collider size and offset, physics debug draw, per-scene gravity, and a game camera with follow, offset, smoothing, dead zone, bounds, zoom, scroll and roll.

areas.name: Audio
areas.detail: Per-object audio sources with clip, volume, loop, mute, pitch and pan plus a project master volume applied in the exported game.

apps.name: Monet Cinema
apps.description: Monet Cinema is a desktop video editor for importing clips, cutting them on a multi-track timeline and grading them. Frame compositing runs in a Rust/WebAssembly engine that the program monitor draws directly, and finished sequences export as an MP4 file or an EDL edit list.

areas.name: Project I/O & delivery

apps.name: Monet Anime
apps.description: Monet Anime is a desktop editor for animated motion graphics, where layers are stacked in a composition and their position, scale, rotation and opacity change over time on a timeline. Preview happens in the browser layout engine, and the only output today is the saved project file, since nothing renders frames or video.

areas.name: Document I/O & interop
areas.detail: Saves and opens the shared .monet container, dispatches by manifest across all seven Monet extensions, resaves byte-identically, carries other apps' payloads through untouched, imports images as embedded data URLs and accepts drag-and-drop.

areas.name: Undo & state
areas.detail: Clone-on-write undo/redo stack capped at 200 entries, drag coalescing by key, a dirty flag, file-path tracking and React binding through useSyncExternalStore.

areas.name: Playback & transport
areas.detail: Wall-clock request-animation-frame player with play, pause and loop, scrubbing with resync, frame stepping at composition frame rate, go-to-start and go-to-end and keyboard transport.

areas.name: MCP automation
areas.detail: 19 @mcp verbs covering document open, layer add and delete, transform set, stopwatch and keyframing, effect add, composition settings and transport, with a generated manifest and a Tauri-side MCP server on port 48216.

areas.name: Workspace shell
areas.detail: Dockable workspace with Layers, Effect Controls and Timeline panels, File, Edit and Layer menus, a status bar, an options bar and keyboard shortcuts.

areas.name: Keyframe animation
areas.detail: Per-property tracks on the eight transform values, 18 easing curves, a stopwatch toggle, key-all-transform and timeline keyframe lanes with drag retiming.

areas.name: Compositing viewport
areas.detail: Layers are composited as CSS-transformed DOM elements at the playhead with opacity, blend modes and filter effects, plus click-to-select and drag-to-move, in a 168-line viewport.

areas.name: Compositions & layers
areas.detail: Five layer kinds (solid, shape, text, image, null) with visibility, lock, blend mode, in and out points and reordering inside a single active composition.

areas.name: Effects
areas.detail: Five parametric effects — Gaussian blur, glow, drop shadow, brightness and tint — added per layer with an enable toggle and scrubbable numeric parameters, mapped onto CSS filters.

areas.name: Render output
areas.detail: There is no rendered output: the only way work leaves the app is the saved .monet project document. No frame, image-sequence or video encoder exists anywhere in the app, and a render queue is listed as not yet built.
